stem: What was one economic effect of the Spanish-American War?

options.label: A
options.text: Shipbuilding industries in the United States declined.

options.label: B
options.text: New free and fair trade treaties were established between the United States and developing countries.

options.label: C
options.text: The United States gained direct access to additional natural resources and overseas markets.

options.label: D
options.text: Demand for coal and petroleum as energy sources declined.
